parsed.notes: The Credit Facility leverage ratio is a debt-to-capitalization style ratio with a limit of 60%, not a debt/EBITDA multiple, so it is classed as 'other'. The interest coverage covenant is an either/or test: the company must meet either the minimum 1.5x Interest Coverage Ratio or a minimum available liquidity amount. Other Credit Facility covenants are dollar thresholds, not ratios, and are omitted: Consolidated Tangible Net Worth (≥ $2,235.2M required, $3,101.5M actual) and Investments in Unrestricted Subsidiaries and Joint Ventures (≤ $930.4M allowed, $9.5M actual). The MIF Mortgage Repurchase Facility also has a leverage covenant (≤ 12.0 to 1.0 required, 6.78 to 1.0 actual), which the MIF Master Repurchase Facility shares. It is excluded because the borrower is the mortgage subsidiary M/I Financial and the facility is a mortgage repurchase/warehouse facility, not the company's bank credit agreement.
